text: Najib isn't a supporting character — he's the whole pitch. A real Syrian vouching for Tbone is what makes the donation button work. Yet Najib says nothing the entire video — he just waves, like an NPC, there only to be photographed next to Tbone at the Sea of Galilee. That's affinity fraud: manufacture the endorsement, then cash the check nobody can verify. And behind the account claiming to be Najib — not one named human being.

So where does that leave Najib? There's no Syrian who posed at the Sea of Galilee — it's physically impossible for the lake to vanish behind his head without a far embankment. He may have stolen an actual person's face. But that's not him.
